content:
priya: follow-up on long-term plan to unify quota accounting across Dedicated + Hosted. current gap: Dedicated uses local credit banks per cluster, Hosted uses central ledger. we need a single logical ledger view so fairness rules apply consistently.

owen: big constraint: Dedicated clusters may be air-gapped occasionally and must continue serving for a short grace window. so any unified design has to support eventual sync and conflict resolution.

dante: proposal: hybrid ledger with eventual reconciliation. each cluster maintains write-ahead logs of local credits; controller maintains canonical ledger and issues reconciled epochs.

sre-bot: note: prior outage 2024-03-12 was caused by ledger divergence during region failover (INC-2024-0312).

priya: conflict resolution: use CRDT-like monotonic counters for credit consumption? tricky because token consumption is subtractive not commutative. alternative: record per-request idempotent events (request_id, delta) and do per-tenant commutative aggregation via vector clocks + tombstones. heavier but robust.

owen: leaning towards event-sourced approach: local append-only logs with per-request events. controller de-dupes on request_id when reconciling. requires unique request ids and bounded retention. downside: storage and bandwidth.

dante: optimization: compress events into per-tenant delta windows every 1s with a bloom filter for request_ids to lower bandwidth. reconciling controller merges deltas and consults bloom filters to detect overlaps; on collision it fetches raw events for that window.

priya: we also must think about fairness enforcement during partition: local cluster should enforce proportional soft caps based on last-known global weights, not free-for-all. propose local provisional quotas that decay if not reconciled. config params: provisional_factor, decay_half_life_s.

sre-bot: recommended defaults from ops: provisional_factor=0.5, decay_half_life_s=300.

owen: billing implications: reconciled controller ledger must mark events as billed when controller confirms. during partition, Dedicated clusters should tag usage as provisional and later finalized. need a chargeback flow and customer-facing reporting.

dante: telemetry/alerts:
- ledger_diverge_count = count(ledger_conflict_events)
- provisional_usage_ratio = sum(provisional_usage) / sum(total_usage)
- reconcile_lag_seconds = now() - last_reconcile_ts

priya: migration: start with read-only canonical view; Dedicated clusters continue local write but stream logs to controller. run reconcile in dry-run mode and surface diffs for 2 weeks. then enable billing-finalization after approvals.

owen: security: events must be signed and include cluster_id + monotonic window id. replay protection via window nonces.

dante: corner-case: double-spend if same request retried and both clusters log it before reconciliation. request_id dedupe and idempotency required in client libs. add client SDK requirement: include uuid4 request_id and retry token.

priya: ops playbook for divergence: if reconcile_lag > 5m and ledger_diff > threshold, roll Dedicated cluster into isolated mode and route high-risk tenants to hosted fallback. incident runbook will be created.

sre-bot: task created: LEDGER-1012 "hybrid ledger reconcile dry-run" assigned to @priya

owen: I'll prototype the delta-bloom approach and measure bandwidth.

priya: thanks. please add your bench numbers to the ticket and we'll sync next week.
